description: This file contains static functions for printing test output in different protocols (CLAP and TAP) for the clar testing framework. It provides functions for printing initialization, test results, errors, suite start, and shutdown messages, tailored to the selected output format.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_init(int test_count,int suite_count)
methods.description: Prints the initial output for the 'clap' protocol, indicating loaded test suites.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_shutdown(int test_count,int suite_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Prints the shutdown message for the 'clap' protocol, including report of all tests.

methods.name: void clar_print_indented(const char * str,int indent)
methods.description: Prints a string with indentation and handles multiline formatting.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_error(int num,const struct clar_report * report,const struct clar_error * error)
methods.description: Outputs the details of a test failure in the 'clap' protocol format.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_ontest(const char * suite_name,const char * test_name,int test_number,enum cl_test_status status)
methods.description: Prints test result status for each test in the 'clap' protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_onsuite(const char * suite_name,int suite_index)
methods.description: Indicates the start of a test suite in the 'clap' protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_onabort(const char * fmt,va_list arg)
methods.description: Outputs an abort message in the 'clap' protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_init(int test_count,int suite_count)
methods.description: Initializes the TAP output, announcing version.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_shutdown(int test_count,int suite_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Outputs the total number of tests at the end in TAP format.

methods.name: void print_escaped(const char * str)

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_onsuite(const char * suite_name,int suite_index)

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_onabort(const char * fmt,va_list arg)
